requirements.statement: When the inner loop exits with no build defect left, or at its cap, verify-functional runs one regression pass that re-exercises and re-judges exactly: (a) every settled-met criterion whose recorded covered files changed after its provenAt; (b) every member of each cause the inner loop fixed (members awaiting regression); (c) every settled-met criterion with no covers record. Must pass: yes.
requirements.source: TRD section 7 Objectives O1; investigation Objectives O1 (PM instruction 2026-11-12)

requirements.statement: A settled-met criterion whose covered files did not change after its provenAt is not re-exercised or re-judged by the regression pass; its verdict, artifact and provenAt stand. Must pass: yes.
requirements.source: TRD section 7 Objectives O2; investigation Objectives O2 (acceptance)

requirements.statement: A criterion met in an early iteration whose covered file a later Debug edit changes is re-checked by the regression pass and, when that edit broke it, is ruled not met (caught) rather than left met. Must pass: yes.
requirements.source: TRD section 7 Objectives O3; investigation Objectives O3 (acceptance)

requirements.statement: The regression pass is the proof: for every criterion it re-checked, the verdict, artifact and provenAt recorded in verification-state.json and the report are the regression pass's, and those are what custody (packages/core/lib/custody.js) reads. Must pass: yes.
requirements.source: TRD section 7 Objectives O4; investigation Objectives O4

requirements.statement: Build defects the regression pass surfaces, and only those, go back to the inner loop for one Debug round, followed by at most one more scoped regression pass. There is never a third pass. Must pass: yes.
requirements.source: TRD section 7 Objectives O5; investigation Objectives O5 (acceptance)

requirements.statement: Evidence gaps and not-checkable results the regression pass produces are recorded with their kind and reason and are not looped on. Must pass: not marked.

open_questions: OQ-1 | The acceptance says "custody reads provenAt from the regression pass", but custody reads status and artifact, never provenAt (custody.js ~:450-500, ~:720-733). | Assumed: no custody behaviour change; a custody test pins that it reads the regression pass's entries (D15). Carried from the investigation. | Why it matters: a custody change nobody needs would be built. | If wrong: a custody rule that should read provenAt is missing.

OQ-2 | How are the two rounds numbered, since provenAt is an iteration number? | Assumed: both keep the exit iteration's number, marked regression: 1 | 2 (D11). Carried from the investigation. | Why it matters: readers that sort by iteration. | If wrong: a reader needs distinct numbers.

OQ-3 | When a regression Debug edits code, the gate the exit Judge ran measured the code before that edit. | Assumed: the gate stays once, with the exit (O7, D12), and the report says it ran before the edits. | Why it matters: a deploy broken by the repair round is reported as passing the gate. | If wrong: the gate should re-run after a repair round; reverses convergence D14 for that case.

OQ-4 | A no-covers criterion (O1c): re-checked whenever the pass runs, or only when something changed? | Assumed: only when a Debug record the round is scored against has non-empty or unknown files (D5). | Why it matters: rounds re-walk criteria nothing could have broken. | If wrong: a no-covers criterion goes un-rechecked after a round that only had awaiting members.

OQ-5 | O1(b) every member of each cause the inner loop fixed: awaiting members only, or representatives too? | Assumed: awaiting members only, as the investigation's O1 says in parentheses; a representative is a settled met covered by (a) or (c). | Why it matters: double-walking representatives. | If wrong: a representative proven at the exit iteration with no later change is not re-walked; that is O2's behaviour.

OQ-6 | Custody, at ship, puts every criterion in doubt when a changed file is claimed by no covers record. Should the regression pass do the same? | Assumed: no; O2 forbids re-walking a criterion whose covered files did not change. Files listed in unclaimedChanges (D5, NG5). | Why it matters: covers that under-cover hide regressions (TR2). | If wrong: the owner wants custody's stricter rule here; that changes O2.

OQ-7 | A met criterion whose regression capture fails as an evidence gap loses its met (D7, D10). | Assumed: yes; O4 makes the pass's verdict the proof and O6 forbids a retry. | Why it matters: coverage can drop and must-pass can block on a capture problem. | If wrong: a failed re-capture should keep the earlier met; that weakens O3.

OQ-8 | The roadmap item 3 brief and the PM instruction disagree on scope. | Assumed: the instruction wins (investigation header); NG1 records the brief's version. | Why it matters: not stated in the TRD. | If wrong: not stated in the TRD.
could_not_verify: Under --criteria (cap: 1) no Debug runs, so no regression pass can run inside a re-proof or its retry (D15). | How to check: inferred from verify-build.md ~:490-512 and decideNext's cap rule; check with a harness run at cap: 1. | Why not checked: needs a harness run.

deriveCriterionCovers maps every criterion of a TRD-derived definition in practice, so (c) is rare. | How to check: run derive-criteria on a recent feature's TRD and definition. | Why not checked: the subcommand is built by REGR-B001 and does not exist yet.
A live Debug reliably reports filesChanged (TR1). | How to check: REGR-T001's transcript. | Why not checked: needs the live fixture run.
